estimates.orbit_text: eccentric; in about the same plane as the distant Kuiper belt objects; perihelion 180 degrees from theirs

estimates.reference: Batygin, Adams, Brown & Becker 2019, Physics Reports
Brown, Holman & Batygin 2024, arXiv:2401.17977 (AJ, in press at listing)
estimates.constraint_text: rules out a Planet Nine with the characteristics predicted in Brown & Batygin (2021) to a 50% completion depth of V = 21.5; with ZTF and DES, 78% of that parameter space is excluded; most of the remainder is at V > 21

pluto_loop.note: fitted_pluto_au is the frozen A4 orbit at the light-emission time; spherex_au is where the telescope was. The apparent loop on the sky comes from the telescope's own motion around the Sun.
